title: Advanced date override handling and timezone compatibility improvements

comments.text: Bug: "end" should use "slotEndTime" instead of "slotStartTime". Working-hours validation therefore uses the same start time for both bounds. Suggests changing the end calculation to use slotEndTime's hour and minute.
Potential issue: "===" for dayjs comparison may not work as expected. Suggests using the .isSame() method on the two adjusted dayjs values instead.
